blockingFindings.description: V76 increases the fitted undershorts hem extension to the supported 80 mm limit, but direct sit and crouch renders still show substantial uncovered anterior thigh above the shorts edge.
The shallow single pleat trial does not resolve the pronounced accordion-like side and rear folds in the standing and seated renders.
The shorter skirt still has an uneven standing hem with a long dropped center-front panel; silhouette remains unresolved.

outOfScope: VRChat Build & Test and runtime inspection
